title: Data steward assigned to the system
question: Has a named data steward been formally assigned to this system?
per_system_justification: Organizational control (roles/responsibilities). Assessed per system as: is a steward assigned to THIS system?

title: AI system impact assessment performed
question: Has an AI system impact assessment been completed for this system?
per_system_justification: Clause 8.4 requires the organization to perform AI system impact assessments per 6.1.4 at planned intervals or on significant change - an unconditional obligation for in-scope AI systems. B.5.2's 'conditions' govern when an assessment is triggered and how detailed it must be, not whether a system may be excluded. Therefore asked for every system and NOT claimable as not-applicable; the AI Governance Team sets depth.

title: Verification and validation performed
question: Has the system been verified and validated against documented acceptance criteria?
per_system_justification: Verification and validation measures apply to the AI system - per system.

title: Operation reviewed within the audit window
question: Has an operational review of this system been performed within the last 180 days?
per_system_justification: Operation and monitoring of the AI system - per system. Review currency used as the operational proxy.

title: Technical documentation maintained
question: Is technical documentation for this system maintained and current?
per_system_justification: Technical documentation is produced for the AI system - per system.

title: Event logging enabled
question: Is event logging enabled for this system in production?
per_system_justification: Event logging enabled at least while the AI system is in use - per system.

title: Data quality regime in place
question: Is a documented data-quality regime in place for this system's data sources?
per_system_justification: Data quality requirements apply to data used to develop/operate the AI system - per system.

title: Data provenance / lineage documented
question: Is data provenance/lineage fully documented for this system?
per_system_justification: Provenance recorded for data used in the AI system - per system.

title: User-facing information provided
question: Is user-facing information provided to people who interact with this system?
per_system_justification: Information for users of the AI system - per system where the system has users.

title: Incident-communication plan in place
question: Are this system's users and AI-specific incident scenarios covered by the organizational incident-communication plan?
per_system_justification: Incident communication is an ORGANIZATIONAL capability (Annex B.8.4 permits integration into wider incident management). Per-system question narrowed to coverage of this system's users and AI-specific scenarios.

title: Human oversight defined (in-the-loop / on-the-loop)
question: What form of human oversight is defined for this system?
not_required_note: This system does not make automated decisions, so ISO 42001 does not require human-in-the-loop oversight here. The organization determines necessity: human-on-the-loop (periodic review of outputs) may still be appropriate. A response is optional for this system - record one if oversight exists.
per_system_justification: A.9.3 / B.9.3: objectives for responsible use, including whether automated decision-making is appropriate and where meaningful human oversight belongs. Necessity is an organizational determination, so the question is shown for every system but only required where automated decisions are made.

title: Intended use documented
question: Intended-use statement for this system (drafted by the business owner, completed and approved by the AI Governance Team)
per_system_justification: Intended use of the AI system - inherently per system.
